tips.title: Ranger Starter
tips.text: This is a early game build for ranger, before getting a lot of stigma and before getting a lot of +skills on gear/arcana cards.

tips.title: Ranger 16 skills/higher stigma
tips.text:
this is 20 deadshot/drill dart/tempest shot

Takeout the 4th node on deadshot, 4th on drill dart and 3rd on tempest shot if those skills aren't lvl 20.

You're eventually aiming for a 20/15/15/1 setup (bow blessing lvl 15 and replace explosive arrow with gryphon arrow at lvl 15 when enough stigma points). Supporting fire is the lowest priority and can stay at low lvl.

tips.title: Ranger 20 skills/high stigma
tips.text: Don't swap to gryphon arrow until it's lvl 15, until then explosive arrow is better.

MANA STONE/ SOUL STONE:
• inferiores: 2 linhas verdes.

• intermediarias: 4 linhas verdes ou 1 azul e 3 verdes.

• superiores: 1 linha dourada dano frontal ou dano de arma.

PEDRA DIVINA:
• Arma e Guarda-braço: Selagem e Paralisia.

ASAS:
• custo beneficio: Asas vakron

• a melhor atualmente: Asas da gruta azul.

• (você precisa de todas asas como "posse" para subir CP)

PANTEON:
• 1 quadro de cada expedição conquista

• 1 estatua draupnir (conquista de fazer 10x): faça sem pegar o bau final, porem faça 5 em uma semana e 5 em outra SE VOCE FIZER

tips.text:
About me:
Hey there, my name is Seth. This is my first attempt in making a build/guide for any kind of game. Take a note that the build is in process of making and many things might change... Im also testing the build currently on TW
Ill do my best to explain what i learned from all the time i played on TW since release. Ill be happy if u decide to start on global with me!

About the Class:
Ranger is highly mobile class, most of the skills can be used while moving and it doesnt have many "casting" abilities. Most of damage we deal is physical. I wouldnt call ranger the best class in Aion 2 however it holds its spots among one of the best in both PVE and PVP depending on a patch.
If You are into playing a class that moves constantly while unleashing barrage of arrows onto enemies this will be certainly a pick for You.

About the Build:
Since the global "stresstest" showed us there is no particular change about the game itself on global version, everythings goes as follows...
Gear:
(Ofc we could stack specific stat like "SMITE" or something like that, id rather give anyone interested global direction than tell u to invest in specific stat that may get nerfed/changed once the game hits)

Our gear rolls should go like this:

Weapon: Weapon - Damage Boost - Combat Speed - Multi-Hit

WeaponGuard - Damage Boost - Combat Speed - Multi-Hit

Helmet: Incoming Heal

Shoulder: Crit Damage Boost

Chest: Damage Boost

Gloves: Combat Speed

Legs: Damage Tolerance

Boots: Movement Speed

Cape: Critical Damage Tolerance

Earrings: Passive Skills/Attack/Crit/Accuracy

Rings: Priority Active Skills/Passive Stats

Neckles: Skills/Attack/Crit/Accuracy

If u decide to stack evasion, make sure to stack it as much as possible on Your gear, since half assing it wont be as effective

Genius Insight:
The stats we should prioritize are Evasion and Accuracy, i would recommend only locking Your stats only after getting gold roll or above. Same as with Manastones if u dont plan on touching any PVP content in the game, instead of Evasion and Accuracy You wanna focus general DPS stats like Attack/Crit

Skills:

Stigma Skills:
The Stigmas i found myself running were: Arrow Storm - Griffon Arrow - Ambush Kick - Vaizel's Authority Im pretty sure this isnt the most optimal stigma build either for PVP or PVE, but i enjoy using those skills and i recommend You to just test stigma skills for Yourself and just run those u enjoy...

Active Skills:
As for active skill i would recommend going like this: (number in bracket means the free upgrade we get for each ability)
Snipe - Lv.20 (3/4/5)
Tempest Shot - Lv20 (2/3/5)
Snare Shot - Lv12 (2/3)
Marking Shot - Lv12 (1/3)
Drill Dart - Lv20 (3/4/5)
Arrow Scattershot - Whatever u feel like
Gale Arrow - Lv20 (3/4/5)
Explosion Trap - Lv12 (1/3)
Burst Arrow - Lv20 (2/4/5)
Suppressing Arrow - Lv12 (1/3)
Deadshot - Lv20 (2/4/5)
Defiance - Lv16 Whatever u feel like
Lv20 leveling priority Deadshot > Gale Arrow > Drill Dart > Snipe > Burst Arrow > Tempest Shot

As for PVP things get little different but as far as my knowledge from TW goes, any kind of self sustain (life steal etc) was meta, tho we have no idea how things will shape out on global launch due to all the changes to avalible stats and time to kill.

ManaStones:
Manastones are getting more important after we reach max level and start acquiring gear that will stay with us for a little longer... there are 2 main stats that we will be looking for, those are Accuracy and Evasion however Attack and Critrolls arent bad for us as well. If ure stictly PVE player focus on Attack/Crit rolls instead of Accuracy and Evasion

Final Toughts after the global Stresstest:
Honestly i dont know if telling u to stack Evasion/Accuracy at the start will be most optimal thing to do, however i belive that if u start investing in it early on it will for sure reward u in the long run... Just remember that as a DPS our role is to output the biggest ammount of damage as possible and defensive stats goe
